snippet.title: SINISOMNIA – Teaser Trailer | Psychological Point-and-Click Game
snippet.description:
🩸 ENTER THE MIND OF A KILLER 🩸  
🔪 씨니섬니아: 포인트 앤 클릭 호러게임 殺人鬼の精神に潜入せよ
Sinisomnia is a psychological point-and-click horror game that traps you in a looping nightmare of uncertainty and dread.

🌀 Escape the nightmare. Face your fears.  
🎮 Available now / Coming soon on Steam:  
🔗 https://store.steampowered.com/app/3582390/Sinisomnia/

🕹️ Developed by [Fiction Roast]
